title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. In addition to the pinned two-project seed, Dossier lifecycle, replay, security, hosting, and reset decisions, it defines a six-case scenario pool, recommends SVG Pelican, Shift Ledger, and The Deep Blue as the first benchmark wave, specifies scripted Orchestrator context-chat runs, a four-category TokenEconomy ledger, immutable Result Dossiers and run history, per-case token caps, staged model comparisons, and clear ownership across the demo, Token Economy, the Agent Studio website, and independently deployed outputs. [Operator approved 2026-08-17: implement as recommended; slices S1-S5 cut as AGT-2666..2670. Implementation state in section 14, curated 2026-08-23: S1 (AGT-2666 seed and gallery), S2 (AGT-2667 hard execution profile), S3 (AGT-2668 replay-only Runner), and S5 (AGT-2670 scrub, bundle, reset contract) are delivered and archived. S4 (AGT-2669, public read-only edge) is in progress on the board. S6 (launch rehearsal) has no task yet. The launch invariant is therefore still not met; this dossier stays out of History until S4 and S6 close.]
